summary: Birkenstock Holding plc filed a Form 6-K announcing subsidiary Birkenstock Group B.V. Co. KG successfully priced €900M of 4.500% Senior Notes due 2033. Net proceeds will redeem €428.5M of 5.25% Senior Notes due 2029 issued by Birkenstock Financing S. r.l. at par on June 26, 2026, fund potential share repurchases disclosed June 15, 2026, or refinance other debt and pay fees. Settlement expected June 19, 2026, with the redemption conditional on closing. This is a routine debt refinancing and liability management transaction, not a special situation; the share repurchase discretion does not constitute a committed capital return program.
